usedFor: Letta holds AI agents, where “Send message to Letta agent” talks to one and “Save memory to Letta” keeps notes.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create Agent” in Letta
bestTemplate.why: The action sets up a new AI agent in Letta, so setup can follow an event elsewhere.

watchOut: “New Messages” is polling, so it checks on a schedule and a short delay is normal.
